text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on your description of the inability to flex the fingertip and the finger resting in an extended position after a forceful pull, this strongly suggests a flexor tendon avulsion, commonly known as a Jersey Finger. To confirm if the tendon has retracted into the palm, I need to visualize the finger's anatomy.
